mentions.notes: From the creators of chicken head pie, pioneering fried chicken in London. Tod highlights them as a notable addition to the festival.

mentions.videoTitle: CRAZY XMAS CHICKEN WING FESTIVAL (Wing Jam) #london #foodie #chicken #festival #food
mentions.notes: The returning champion and three-time winner of the wing competition. Tod recognizes them as a top performer at the festival.

mentions.videoTitle: Sunday lunch at one of the oldest pubs in London #roast #london #foodie #food
mentions.notes: Historic pub dating back to 1675 famous for its Sunday roast and lamb chops cooked on the grill. Tod praised the perfectly executed roast dinner with great beef, fluffy roast potatoes, savory pancake, and crackling, noting it reminds him of his grandma's cooking and that the Guinness is creamy and excellent.

mentions.videoTitle: New favourite Indian food in London #indian #foodie #food #london #shorts
mentions.notes: A boutique Punjabi restaurant famous for their lobster biryani. Tod describes it as a potential new favourite, praising the fresh tandoor-roasted meats, crispy masala chips, moist and flavourful biryani with whole lobster, perfectly balanced paneer maccani, and a standout galop meringue cheesecake that ranks among his top five meals of the year.

mentions.videoTitle: Hunting for Londons best burger AD #burger #london #foodie
mentions.notes: Uses 30-day dry-aged beef patties that are pressed to retain juices. Offers burgers like the double dirty barbie with candied bacon, American cheese, caramelized onions, and homemade BBQ sauce, plus exclusive Uber Eats deals and in-house fried chicken with homemade Korean sauce.

mentions.videoTitle: Best desi pub in London ? #indian #london #foodie
mentions.notes: Described as the best desi pub in London with exceptional mixed grill and tandoori dishes. The 2.5kg leg of lamb sharing dish (£64.50 for six people) was called the best value for money lamb sharing dish Tod has had, with meat that falls apart and incredible flavour from approximately 50 spices.

mentions.videoTitle: Craziest roast dinner in London #roast #london #Foodie #food #roastbeef
mentions.notes: Tod describes an elaborate £60 per person sharing roast dinner featuring slow-cooked ribs, fire-kissed lamb, dry-aged beef, whole chicken, and a suckling pig cooked on a kebab spit and carved tableside, all finished with 24-hour beef bone gravy. He praises the tender beef, depth of flavor in the gravy, and particularly highlights the bacon rib Yorkshire puddings as his favorite part of the meal.

mentions.videoTitle: Most famous sandwich shop in the world in London #food #london #sandwich #shorts
mentions.notes: An Italian sandwich shop famous for Sketcha bread and imported meats from Tuscany. Tod loved the quality of the sandwiches, praising the fatty, salty salami, the crispiness of the bread, and the combination of roasted porchetta with smoked provolone, though he humorously noted the richness requires dental checkups.

mentions.videoTitle: Secret garden seafood boil #london #seafoodboil #foodie #lobster
mentions.notes: A back garden supper club restaurant run by Gemma offering seafood boil experiences at £30 per person with seafood sourced from Billingsgate Market. Tod describes the lobster tail with Cajun sauce as an 'outer body experience' and praises the homemade sauce with around 50 spices as exceptional.

mentions.videoTitle: Desi pub Sunday roast in London #desi #indianfood #roast #london #shorts
mentions.notes: A desi pub serving Indian-British fusion roasts. Tod praised their handmade onion bhajees as "the best onion bargie I've ever put in my mouth," the masala lamb shank roast cooked for 6 hours with incredible depth of flavor, and their soft, crispy, buttery rotties.

mentions.videoTitle: Desi pub Sunday roast in London #desi #indianfood #roast #london #shorts
mentions.notes: Sister restaurant to Teml Crown, mentioned as the source of famous rotties that are served at Teml Crown. Tod described the rotties as soft, crispy, and buttery with exceptional quality.

mentions.videoTitle: Best steakhouse in London ft Man vs Food #food #steak #foodie #london
mentions.notes: Crowned the 11th best steakhouse in the world, specializing in Ruby Galiqa ox imported from northern Spain. They served an exceptional 3kg+ steak cooked nine times on the grill, along with Wagyu T-bone, crab pinchos, and king crab paella that Tod and guest Adam Richmond found extraordinary.

mentions.videoTitle: Biggest Steak We’ve Ever Eaten FT. Man Vs Food
mentions.notes: London's highest-rated steakhouse and 11th best steakhouse in the world. Specializes in Basque steak perfection with dry-aged Galician blonde beef, led by meat master Richard Foster. Tod and Adam were extremely impressed with the quality, tenderness, and flavor of the steaks, describing them as exceptional and comparing the experience to 'primordial steak.'

mentions.videoTitle: UK’S BEST BRAZILIAN CHURRASCO EXPERIENCE WITH UNLIMITED MEAT? AD #london #foodie #food #steak
mentions.notes: A premium Brazilian churrasco restaurant offering unlimited meat service with up to 15 different cuts including lamb pana, ribeye, pork collar, and fillet steaks, plus access to a market table with hot sides. Tod describes it as "head and tails above anything else" he's experienced in this category, with perfectly cooked meats and optional upgrades including lobster tail and free dessert.

mentions.videoTitle: Burgers and Nashville chicken 🔥 ad #burger #london #foodie
mentions.notes: Tod praised their in-house minced beef patties with amazing crust, creamy homemade sauce, and soft buttery Martins potato rolls. He also highlighted their new Nashville fried chicken range, featuring crispy battered chicken marinated in buttermilk and coated with a punchy, fiery Nashville seasoning rub.

mentions.videoTitle: Trying the Best Fusion BBQ in Texas
mentions.notes: Tod mentions that KG Barbecue will be coming to London in September for the Fume Barbecue Festival. Tod expresses excitement about seeing KG in London.

mentions.videoTitle: Trying viral fruit pastries in London #pastry #fruit #london #foodie #shorts
mentions.notes: Tod tried 12 fruit pastries costing £86 total. He was impressed by the crunch, variety of flavours (mango, apple, lemon, raspberry, strawberry, coconut), and intricate design, though he didn't enjoy the coconut pastry.

mentions.videoTitle: Trying viral fruit pastries in London #pastry #fruit #london #foodie #shorts
mentions.notes: Mentioned as a reference point for viral fruit pastries, charging £25 for an edible fruit pastry. No direct review or sentiment expressed.

mentions.videoTitle: 5am Handpulled Noodles In London’s Chinatown #noodles #foodie #cheap #chinatown #shorts
mentions.notes: The most famous handpulled noodle shop in London serving noodles until 5am with a Chinese buffet at front and noodle makers at back. Tod praised the handpulled noodles with beef for perfect texture and braised beef, calling the hand-cut noodles with charu pork 'a steal' at £10, though found some dishes slightly slimy.

name: From the Ashes at the Ned

mentions.videoTitle: Michelin star Texas bbq in LONDON!!! #food #texas #bbq #london #shorts
mentions.notes: Hosting a collaboration with Interstellar, a Texas smokehouse, featuring pit masters from Austin serving Texas barbecue classics including 12-hour smoked Australian Wagyu brisket, short ribs, peach tea glazed pork belly bites, slow-cooked lamb, cowboy beans, jalapeño and cheddar sausage, and smoked duck legs. Tod praised the food highly and expressed gratitude to the owner John for bringing this experience to London.

mentions.videoTitle: Londons new Spanish restaurant 🔥 🇪🇸 #london #foodie #spain #food #shorts
mentions.notes: A new Spanish restaurant featuring woodfired ovens imported from Spain and multiple cooking stations. Tod praised the grilled octopus, stewed oxtails, suckling pig, and woodfired milkfed lamb's leg as exceptional dishes, calling the suckling pig "hands down one of the best" he's ever had.

mentions.videoTitle: £1 BURGERS IN LONDON ad #burgers #cheap #london #shorts
mentions.notes: Offers £1 burgers from their proper burger range via the Neotastaster app, including premium options like double beef bacon cheeseburger. Tod describes it as "hands down one of the best deals I've ever heard of."

mentions.videoTitle: £1 BURGERS IN LONDON ad #burgers #cheap #london #shorts
mentions.notes: Features a pulled beef burger with homemade gravy for £1 via the Neotastaster app. Tod describes it as potentially "the world's messiest burger" in a complimentary way.

mentions.videoTitle: Hunting for London’s best basque restaurant #basque #london #foodie #shorts
mentions.notes: A Spanish institution in London famous for their Basque cheesecake. Tod praised multiple dishes including the 40-day dry-aged ribeye, lobster with smoky pepper sauce, and the cheesecake which he described as one of the best he's ever had.

mentions.videoTitle: New £7 banana pudding shop in London - wow 😮 #banana #pudding #london #bakery #foodie
mentions.notes: A new banana pudding shop serving fresh puddings made daily in the window at around £7 per portion. Tod was extremely impressed with the classic banana pudding, praising its layers, creamy vanilla custard texture, and mousselike pudding, and found it comparable to the original Magnolia Bakery in New York.

mentions.videoTitle: Londons most unique fire experience #grill #foodie #food #london #michelin
mentions.notes: A unique fire experience featuring a 4m bespoke grill with handmade cooking tools, led by chef Robbie Jameson who achieved a Michelin star within 8 months of opening. Tod praised multiple dishes including hand-dived scallops, Scottish lobster, 30-day aged wood-fired lamb, and innovative preparations like year-aged tuna and black truffle cauliflower cheese.

mentions.videoTitle: Hunting for London’s best Punjab food AD #pubjab #indianfood #food #foodie
mentions.notes: Tod describes it as "hands down one of the best Punjabi restaurants" he's ever been to. He praised the mixed grill, tandoor chicken, pani puri, and particularly highlighted the doll as "the best doll I've ever eaten in my life," along with the butter chicken and fresh naans.

mentions.videoTitle: NEW DIY Hot Pot in London Chinatown #hotpot #chinatown #malatang #london #food #shorts (ad)
mentions.notes: A DIY hot pot restaurant where customers fill bowls with over 80 ingredients and choose from six types of noodles, then have chefs cook them in broths ranging from herbal beef bone to peanut butter dry spice. Tod praised the dumplings, beef broth's rich umami flavor, and the dry spice mix with peanut butter sauce, with each pot costing around £20.

mentions.videoTitle: £100 Challenge at London’s Biggest Asian Food Hall #food #foodchallenge #asian #london #shorts
mentions.notes: London's biggest Asian food hall with over 40 traders offering Indian, Malaysian, Korean, Chinese, and Japanese cuisine. Tod completed a £100 challenge sampling Taiwanese fried chicken, orange chicken and noodles, Cantonese roast duck, nasty lac, fried sea bass, ramen, and bing soo dessert.

mentions.videoTitle: £100 Challenge at London’s Biggest Asian Food Hall #food #foodchallenge #asian #london #shorts
mentions.notes: Serves orange chicken and noodles with massive plates and excellent value for money. The sauce was sweet and sticky with chicken the size of a golf ball.

mentions.videoTitle: £100 Challenge at London’s Biggest Asian Food Hall #food #foodchallenge #asian #london #shorts
mentions.notes: Offers Cantonese roast duck that is very tender with a slight sweetness from caramelization.

mentions.videoTitle: BEST AND WORSE OF LONDON CHINATOWN  Ft. Morgan Jay
mentions.notes: Cantonese roast meat spot serving roast duck, roast pork, and crispy pork belly. Tod praised the pork belly and duck but docked points because the food wasn't piping hot and the duck skin could have been crispier.

mentions.videoTitle: £100 Challenge at London’s Biggest Asian Food Hall #food #foodchallenge #asian #london #shorts
mentions.notes: Serves nasty lac with incredible flavour, though Tod would have preferred the roti to be crispier.

mentions.videoTitle: £100 Challenge at London’s Biggest Asian Food Hall #food #foodchallenge #asian #london #shorts
mentions.notes: Prepares sushi to order and serves ramen with a broth that has been boiling for days and perfectly chewy noodles.

mentions.videoTitle: INCREDIBLE Roadside Caribbean restaurant in London! #london #jerk #foodie #shorts
mentions.notes: A roadside Caribbean restaurant where Alex hand-builds everything from scratch, including jerk cooking equipment from oil drums. Tod was particularly impressed by the jerk chicken with crispy skin and tender meat, the rice and peas with creamy coconut flavor, and the festival (dumpling-donut hybrid) paired with curry goat, which he called a 'mouth wobbler.'

mentions.videoTitle: Is this Britain’s best burger? #burger #shorts #foodie #uk
mentions.notes: Chef Jeremy, who trained at Michelin star restaurants, creates burgers from scratch with homemade buns, chipotle ketchup, and dry-aged bacon. Tod describes the attention to detail as exceptional and the burgers as some of the best he's tried, along with fresh-made fries with homemade garlic and rosemary oil.

mentions.videoTitle: BEST AND WORSE OF LONDON CHINATOWN  Ft. Morgan Jay
mentions.notes: Korean corn dog battered in noodles and filled with mozzarella cheese. Tod found it edible but lacking in flavor and nutritional value, describing it as just fried cheese with no real taste.

mentions.videoTitle: BEST AND WORSE OF LONDON CHINATOWN  Ft. Morgan Jay
mentions.notes: Specializes in custard buns that are filled with creamy custard yolk and carrot juice. Tod praised it as one of the places in Chinatown that really tastes good, with fantastic texture and flavor.

name: Deep Fried Chicken / Bubble the JG Chicken

mentions.videoTitle: BEST AND WORSE OF LONDON CHINATOWN  Ft. Morgan Jay
mentions.notes: Taiwanese fried chicken popcorn with curry, garlic, cheese, chili, and garlic seasonings. Tod gave it a perfect 10/10, calling it delicious and noting the seasoning makes it require no dipping sauce.

mentions.videoTitle: BEST AND WORSE OF LONDON CHINATOWN  Ft. Morgan Jay
mentions.notes: Described as the rudest restaurant in Chinatown with a 3.5 rating online. Cash only with no service charge policy; Tod's interaction at the beginning suggests a dismissive service experience.

mentions.videoTitle: BOGOF NEOPLITAN PIZZAS IN LONDON 🍕 (ad) #pizza #london #foodie #shorts
mentions.notes: Awarded 33rd best pizza chain in the world, specializing in four different types of dough. Tod praised the traditional dough pizza with its perfect chew, the truffle-based pizza with spicy heat, and the flat dough pizza with blue cheese and honey, all available as BOGOF on Uber Eats.

mentions.videoTitle: London’s newest French brassiere #london #french #dessert #foodie #shorts
mentions.notes: A newly opened Parisian brasserie viral for their dessert selection. Tod praised nearly every dish including the Duchess potato, wagyu burger, fillet steak with peppercorn sauce, king prawns with cognac thermidor sauce, and salted milk chocolate cookies, though he criticized the £9 portion of chips as overpriced.

mentions.videoTitle: I tried three Michelin star food for the first time #london #michelin #foodie #shorts
mentions.notes: Three Michelin star restaurant featuring multi-sensory dishes like lime grove frozen mousse, snail porridge, scallop with white chocolate and caviar, and triple cooked chips. Tod was highly impressed with the innovative cooking and execution of dishes.

mentions.videoTitle: London’s Flooding Pub #london #pub #flood #funny #londonlife #shorts
mentions.notes: A unique pub that floods at high tide, offering roast dinners on Sundays and fish and chips. Tod praised the Yorkshire puddings and fish and chips particularly, highlighting the crunch and overall quality of the food service even during flood conditions.

mentions.videoTitle: Best afghan food in London? #london #foodie #afghanistan #food #shorts
mentions.notes: Afghan restaurant featuring a huge charcoal grill and curries made from scratch. Tod praised the Afghan mixed grill (particularly lamb sheet kebabs and lamb chops), chicken kari served sizzling on the bone, oversized Afghan naan bread made to order, and the chapley kebab which he described as his favourite dish with insane flavour and crispy exterior.

mentions.videoTitle: Best Indian restaurant in the world is in London #indianfood #london #curry #food #india foodie
mentions.notes: A two Michelin star Indian restaurant featuring standout dishes like pani puri, lamb brain burger, masala butter chicken, monk jack biryani, and lamb chops. Tod praised the complexity of spices and the quality of meat preparation, describing the flavors as exceptional and hallucination-inducing.

mentions.videoTitle: London’s newest butchery and rotisserie chicken shop #london #food #butcher #shorts
mentions.notes: A butchery and rotisserie chicken shop featuring an imported Parisian rotisserie machine. The rotisserie chickens are exceptional with incredibly tender legs and delicate breast meat, served with potatoes cooked in chicken fat that burst with flavor.

mentions.videoTitle: Dinning at the UK’s best restaurant 🌟 🌟 #ritz #london #foodie #food #michelin #foodreview
mentions.notes: A world-famous hotel with classically French cuisine with modern refinement, orchestrated by chef John Williams. The restaurant features exceptional theatre-style service with multiple trolleys, signature dishes like pigeon aless and chocolate soufflé, and an extensive 73-page wine list.

mentions.videoTitle: Best cheap eats in London (UNDER £5) ad #london #foodie #cheap #shorts
mentions.notes: Offers pastel dinata and coffee for £1 with fresh pastries baked every hour. Hand-molded pastries filled with homemade custard that caramelizes in the oven, creating an insane crunch with buttery creamy filling.

mentions.videoTitle: Best cheap eats in London (UNDER £5) ad #london #foodie #cheap #shorts
mentions.notes: Serves eight wings for £5 (60p per wing). Tod describes the Buffalo wing as his favorite wing of all time with sauce that is addictively good.

mentions.videoTitle: Best cheap eats in London (UNDER £5) ad #london #foodie #cheap #shorts
mentions.notes: Open until 3 a.m. and offers one pound margarita pizzas (12p per slice) made fresh to order with free chili oil.

mentions.videoTitle: Best cheap eats in London (UNDER £5) ad #london #foodie #cheap #shorts
mentions.notes: Offers £3 takeaway schnitzel (pork or chicken) hand-bashed to order with free garlic butter and lemon. Tod describes the combination as a match made in heaven.

mentions.videoTitle: Best cheap eats in London (UNDER £5) ad #london #foodie #cheap #shorts
mentions.notes: Serves souffle pancakes for £3 in London with flavors including creme brulee, pistachio, and tiramisu. Pancakes are described as super wiggly.

mentions.videoTitle: Best seafood restaurant in London #seafood #london #foodie #shorts
mentions.notes: Over 110 years old seafood restaurant headed by Richard Corrian. Features exceptional oysters, seafood platters, turbot finished with potted shrimp and butter carved tableside, and highly praised fish pie that Tod claims is the best he's ever had.

mentions.videoTitle: Wagyu sushi experience in London AD #london #sushi #wagyu
mentions.notes: Features three sushi masters handcrafting sushi rolls with a head chef from Tokyo. Offers exceptional A4 Wagyu prepared two ways (Wagyu nigiri and Wagyu beef roll with truffle), fresh seafood sushi, and a standout 'super donut' dish described as katsu curry with dumplings and meat skewers that Tod calls 'the definition of the perfect lunch.'

mentions.videoTitle: Hunting for the best Soul Food in London AD #food #london #soulfood #shorts
mentions.notes: Specializes in big seafood and meat platters. Highlights include Bang Bang prawns, jerk chicken, Cajun wings, mac and cheese, and lobster tail with butter sauce and Cajun rub. Mac and cheese praised as 'top tier' — creamy, cheesy with a hit of spice.

mentions.videoTitle: £10 Guide To London’s Best Eats #cheapeat #affordable #london #food #shorts
mentions.notes: Offers a full English breakfast with double eggs, double bacon, and double sausages plus a free cup of tea for £6.

mentions.videoTitle: £10 Guide To London’s Best Eats #cheapeat #affordable #london #food #shorts
mentions.notes: Hand-cut noodles for £10, open until 5:00 a.m., with freshly pulled noodles and delicious broth.

mentions.videoTitle: £10 Guide To London’s Best Eats #cheapeat #affordable #london #food #shorts
mentions.notes: Serves a loaded kebab naan for £2.49 with fresh butter-brushed naan, two lamb sheet kebabs, homemade chili and garlic sauces, and salad.

mentions.videoTitle: £10 Guide To London’s Best Eats #cheapeat #affordable #london #food #shorts
mentions.notes: Offers a cheesecake that Tod describes as a 'foreverlasting memory' and the best cheesecake he's ever eaten.

mentions.videoTitle: £10 Guide To London’s Best Eats #cheapeat #affordable #london #food #shorts
mentions.notes: A supermarket and butcher serving London's cheapest chicken shawarma for £3, described as unbeatable value.

mentions.videoTitle: £10 Guide To London’s Best Eats #cheapeat #affordable #london #food #shorts
mentions.notes: Serves pizza slices with daily specials including candied jalapeno, pepperoni, and hot honey pizza; a whole slice costs £7 and is larger than a normal pizza.
